content.text:
Finding submitted.

**INDEMN — missing (critical), preferred level.**

- **Investigation:** Searches for "indemnify / hold harmless / defend", "indemnification", and "infringe intellectual property" returned nothing. I read every section: Section 9 (Warranties) contains only mutual authority representations plus the Globix carve-out; Section 10 (General Provisions) is boilerplate; there is no limitation-of-liability or super-cap anywhere. The only IP-adjacent language is the advertising covenant in p0046, which is not an indemnity.
- **Classification:** No Vendor IP indemnity at all — walk-away territory, so a redline is warranted.
- **Target choice:** Preferred, because the deal has no "annual fees" construct (HDI is paid a share of Net Sales), making the fallback 3× annual fees super-cap unworkable, and preferred does not cap our recovery.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` p0058 (end of the warranty section, immediately before Section 10) adding new Section 9A carrying all ten preferred elements: HDI defence/indemnity for the Company and its affiliates against third-party claims for IP infringement by the Site, Services or deliverables, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused unauthorized access to Company data/Confidential Information, and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct; notice, control of defence and reasonable cooperation; and a Company indemnity confined to Company-provided Content and our own breach of law. No survival tail, expense language or other non-element boilerplate was added.
